subject: AWS Channel Private Offer: Invoicing & Legal Pre-reqs for Reseller Launch
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Eli Torres <eli.torres@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, aws-cp@amazon.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: AWS Channel Private Offer: Invoicing & Legal Pre-reqs for Reseller Launch

Eli — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick follow-up to align on the operational pieces we need to launch the AWS CPPO with CloudResell as our reseller for ACME Corp. We want to avoid surprises on who invoices who, tax handling, and the minimal legal artifacts AWS will expect before they accept the private offer.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm whether CloudResell will issue the invoice to ACME (reseller model) or whether Redwood will invoice ACME and CloudResell handles channel credits (if you have a preferred flow, please state).
- Any reseller-specific W-9 / tax forms or VAT registration details we should collect for ACME regionally?
- Legal artifacts: does CloudResell require a reseller addendum to Redwood’s MSA, or will the AWS CPPO acceptance suffice?
- AWS steps: do you need Redwood to upload a Marketplace listing or just the private offer ID? We'll attach the CPPO terms draft and an invoice flow diagram for reference.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred invoicing flow by EOD tomorrow.
2) We’ll share a one-page reseller onboarding form to collect tax/legal info.
3) Ben (cc’d) will validate billing integration assumptions; Sergio will coordinate the AWS-side CPPO creation with the AWS partner rep.

Attachments: CPPO_Terms_v3.pdf (draft), invoice_flow_diagram.png, reseller_onboarding_form.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

— Rachel Kim
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Eli Torres <eli.torres@cloudresell.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-ops@cloudresell.com, aws-cp@amazon.com
Date: 2026-12-01T12:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Channel Private Offer: Invoicing & Legal Pre-reqs for Reseller Launch

Rachel — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers from our ops side after syncing with finance: 

- Preferred invoicing flow: CloudResell will invoice ACME for the full purchase (reseller invoice). CloudResell then settles with Redwood monthly via a credit note on the committed CPPO value. This is our standard reseller flow for private offers.
- Tax/VAT: ACME is US-headquartered but purchases through their EU subsidiary for this deal; we need Redwood to provide VAT reverse-charge supporting docs (supplier VAT ID) and a copy of your US EIN for our records.
- Legal: We do prefer a short reseller addendum to Redwood’s MSA outlining channel margins, indemnities, and data responsibilities. AWS accepts private offers without an addendum, but for our audit we need that document in place before first invoice. A one-page addendum template is fine.
- AWS steps: We just need the private offer ID and confirmation that Redwood’s marketplace listing SKU maps to the offer. Please also cc aws-cp@amazon.com when you submit the CPPO so the ASG team can fast-track acceptance.

I'll attach our reseller onboarding checklist (sent separately by partner-ops) and will aim to provide the tax forms we need by tomorrow afternoon. If Ben wants to join a 30-min ops sync, I'm available 11am–1pm PT tomorrow.

— Eli Torres
VP, Channel Sales | CloudResell LLC
eli.torres@cloudresell.com | +1 (206) 555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Eli Torres <eli.torres@cloudresell.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Channel Private Offer: Invoicing & Legal Pre-reqs for Reseller Launch

Rachel / Eli — quick technical billing notes from finance/ops: 

- If CloudResell invoices ACME, we need to ensure the CPPO invoice reconciliation fields are consistent (Offer ID, Marketplace SKU, Customer AWS account ID). Please confirm which SKU Redwood will expose in the CPPO so our downstream ETL can pick it up.
- For the monthly settlement between CloudResell and Redwood, we prefer a net-30 credit-note process. We will require CloudResell to send remittance details and a contact for AP reconciliation.
- Tax documents: Eli, please route the onboarding checklist back to us with the reseller VAT/ EIN fields populated. Redwood legal will draft a one-page reseller addendum and circulate it for a quick signature (DocuSign link).

Operational question: do we need to create a separate CPPO per region (US/EU) given ACME’s multi-entity purchase? AWS sometimes enforces entity-specific private offers. Sergio — can you confirm the AWS marketplace constraints here?

If useful, I can put together a 1-pager with the minimal reconciliation fields for the CPPO acceptance — aim to share by EOD.

— Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Eli Torres <eli.torres@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, aws-cp@amazon.com
Date: 2026-12-03T15:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Channel Private Offer: Invoicing & Legal Pre-reqs for Reseller Launch

Thanks everyone — summary & plan below to keep momentum: 

Summary decisions:
- Invoicing: CloudResell will invoice ACME. Redwood and CloudResell will settle monthly via credit notes (net-30).
- Legal: Redwood legal will prepare a one-page reseller addendum and send via DocuSign; CloudResell to return signed addendum before first invoice.
- AWS / CPPO: Redwood will create the private offer and share the Offer ID + SKU mapping; Sergio will confirm whether we need separate per-entity CPPO for US/EU (action: Sergio, please confirm by tomorrow).
- Tax: Eli to provide reseller VAT / EIN and any ACME EU purchasing entity details; Ben to request Redwood’s VAT ID / EIN from finance and share to Eli.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Eli / CloudResell: return onboarding checklist with VAT/EIN details (by 2026-12-02 — received partial; please update with EU entity info).
- Ben: share Redwood tax identifiers and the 1-pager reconciliation fields (by 2026-12-03 — Ben to upload to the shared Drive link).
- Sergio: confirm CPPO per-entity requirement with AWS (by 2026-12-04).
- Rachel: upload CPPO_Terms_v3, start private offer creation once we have SKU mapping, and circulate reseller addendum draft (by 2026-12-04).

If no objections, I'll schedule a 30-minute launch checklist call for 2026-12-04 10:30am PT to finalize items. Eli — does that slot work for you?

Thanks — excited to get this live for ACME next week.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
